## Open

### F-792 — The cycle's own cleanup makes the next cycle red

> _2026-11-21 · suite/blong-suite · open_

The developer's cycle (`suite/blong-suite/deploy.sh`) ends with `DROP_SERVICES=1`, which deletes
every workload, claim and Service labelled `part-of=blong-suite` in `blong-services` — including
`mysql`, the service the same script switches off (`SERVICE_OFF=mysql`) for the run it just made.
The next cycle is then red on the runbook's own assertion, which is the _opposite_ of the drop: a
switched-off service's workload is the tenant's to retire, so the runbook fails when
`deployment/mysql` is gone ("mysql was switched off and deployment/mysql is gone with it", D-461).

So a cycle that ends with the drop makes the following run fail before any of its own work is
judged, and the two settings have to be read together to see it: `DROP_SERVICES=0` keeps the state
the next run's switch-off assertion expects, and a run that did drop it needs one `SERVICE_ON=mysql`
run — with `ARTIFACT_URL` set, because `suite deploy` alone has no machine half to publish one — to
put it back. Worth fixing where the two are declared: the drop belongs _after_ the runbook's
judgement of the next run's service, not before it, or the assertion should accept a namespace that
was emptied deliberately.
